crew.overview: A raw and emotionally revealing look at one of the most iconic artists of our time during a transformational period in her life as she learns to embrace her role not only as a songwriter and performer, but as a woman harnessing the full power of her voice.
crew.title: Miss Americana

details.biography: Emily Topper is a cinematographer. She has shot films for PBS, Netflix, Tremolo, Meridian Hill Pictures, Drifting Cloud Productions, Optimist, Field of Vision, The California Endowment, The New York Times, Hairpin Communication, Loteria Films, Vice, Motherboard, Sandbox Films, The Redford Center, and countless others.
details.name: Emily Topper
